question.problem: Calculate the discriminant of the quadratic equation $-2x^2+5x-1=0.$
question.worked_solution:
We have $a=-2,$ $b=5,$ and $c=-1.$ So, we calculate the discriminant as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}D & ={b}^{2}-4ac \\  & =(5)^{2}-4(-2)(-1) \\  & =25-8 \\  & =17\end{aligned}
$$
